description: buildSeedPlan's `!parentWallet || !childWallet` guard (lib/seed.js:10-12, throws 'parent/child wallet required') has zero test coverage -- no test in lib/__tests__/seed.test.js ever passes a falsy/missing parentWallet or childWallet. Also untested: the exact boundary `parentBalanceUsdc === seedUsdc`, which per REQ-3 (only '<' throws) must SUCCEED; the current suite only tests strictly-less-than ('throws when balance < seed', seed.test.js:30-32) and never confirms the equality boundary actually returns a plan instead of throwing. A regression that changed '<' to '<=' would pass every existing test while silently blocking legitimate exact-balance seeds.

evidence.snippet: (no test constructs { parentWallet: undefined } / { childWallet: '' } / { parentBalanceUsdc: seedUsdc } anywhere in this file)
